ns2:course.label: Ancient Greek Sanctuaries
ns2:course.description: Survey of the archaeological remains of ancient Greek sanctuaries and their importance to ancient society and religion. Same as ARTH 218, and RLST 232. Prerequisite: Sophomore standing or consent of instructor.
